title: Four beliefs that cause bad connector requests

hotspots.label: Myth: a custom connector is supported like a native one.
hotspots.detail: Partner connectors are developed and supported by the partner organization, and shared push connector code may have limited support. Name the owner before you build.

hotspots.label: Myth: connecting an MCP server makes the source searchable.
hotspots.detail: Tools retrieve current data or perform actions at request time. They do not make source content searchable.

hotspots.label: Myth: a missing facet on Drive needs a custom Drive connector.
hotspots.detail: Custom Metadata attaches metadata to documents from any datasource, including native connectors, without re-indexing the source document.

hotspots.label: Myth: once content is in Glean, the source never checks access again.
hotspots.detail: Glean applies the permission snapshot mirrored during crawling. Opening a result usually sends the user to the source, which may enforce access again.
